description: Source code for voice handling in the Unvanquished game, including parsing voice scripts, managing voice commands, tracks, and associated data structures.

classes.name: voice_t
classes.description: Represents a voice set, including its name and associated commands.

classes.name: voiceCmd_t
classes.description: Represents a voice command with its associated tracks.

classes.name: voiceTrack_t
classes.description: Represents a track within a voice command, including team, class, text, and other attributes.

methods.name: BG_VoiceParseError
methods.description: Handles parse errors by reporting the source file and line, then terminating.

methods.name: BG_VoiceList
methods.description: Loads the list of voice files from the filesystem.

methods.name: BG_VoiceParseTrack
methods.description: Parses a voice track from the script file.

methods.name: BG_VoiceParseCommand
methods.description: Parses a voice command, including its tracks.

methods.name: BG_VoiceParse
methods.description: Parses a voice script file into command and track structures.

methods.name: BG_VoiceInit
methods.description: Initializes voice data by loading and parsing voice scripts.

methods.name: BG_PrintVoices
methods.description: Prints the list of voices and their details for debugging.

methods.name: BG_VoiceByName
methods.description: Finds a voice set by name.

methods.name: BG_VoiceCmdFind
methods.description: Finds a voice command by name within a voice set.

methods.name: BG_VoiceCmdByNum
methods.description: Retrieves a voice command by its index.

methods.name: BG_VoiceTrackByNum
methods.description: Retrieves a voice track by its index.

methods.name: BG_VoiceTrackFind
methods.description: Finds a voice track matching team, class, and enthusiasm criteria.
